routes.label: Scale the numerator and denominator equally

question:
Which of the following is equal to

\[\frac{9}{7 \times 53}?\]
solution:
A quotient stays the same when its numerator and denominator are both divided by the same nonzero number. Divide both by \(10\). Since dividing the factor \(7\) by \(10\) divides the whole product \(7\times53\) by \(10\), we obtain
\[
\frac{9}{7\times53}
=\frac{9\div10}{(7\times53)\div10}
=\frac{0.9}{0.7\times53}.
\]
This is choice A.
